newsitem.title: USA: Jury issues indictment vs KBF Pollution.
newsitem.headline: Jury issues indictment vs KBF Pollution.

text.p: KBF Pollution Management Inc said on Friday a grand jury in New York has issued an indictment against the company and Larry Kreisler, its president, relating to sewer discharge.

The indictment, which had eight counts, charged KBF diluted discharge to the sewer system to achieve discharge standards and it kept false records relating to discharges between January 1988 and April 1996, it said.
It also charged illegal dealing in hazardous waste and five counts of filing a false document, KBF said.
The company said all counts except the first related to activities that took place before September 1994.
There was no allegation that KBF or its employees caused any damage to the environment, it said.
KFB said Kreisler denied all the allegations and said a motion to dismiss would be filed as soon as possible.
The company said the charges stemmed from claims by disgruntled former employees who had been discharged for cause.
